Plan each month day by day. MPOs plan and submit to their FM; FMs review, then plan and submit to the BM. Stops are suggested only from towns, doctors, pharmacies and hospitals already mapped in this dashboard. Totals use the same formulas as the Excel plan.

Monthly expense reimbursement for MPO, FM and BM. The Tour column fills itself from the doctor and pharmacy areas recorded each day; you type batta, night out and other expenses, and every total is calculated. Submit to your manager for approval, then download the Excel in the company expense format.
